description: This file provides utility functions for handling date and time-related operations, including converting local datetime strings to ISO format, formatting ISO timestamps for display, and checking if a timestamp falls within a specified window.

methods.name: localDateTimeToIso(localValue)
methods.description: Converts a local datetime string in the format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm to an ISO string, returning null if input is invalid or empty.

methods.name: formatDateTime(iso)
methods.description: Formats an ISO timestamp into a locale-specific string for display; returns '-' if input is falsy and preserves the original string if it cannot be parsed.

methods.name: isWithinWindow(iso, fromIso, toIso)
methods.description: Checks whether an ISO timestamp falls within the specified range [fromIso, toIso], considering unbounded sides if either boundary is null.
